data.title: Bluebird Mining Ventures Reports Shift Toward Gold and Bitcoin Streaming Model
data.description: Bluebird Mining Ventures (LSE:BMV) reported interim results covering its transition from legacy exploration activities toward a business model focused on gold streaming, mining and treasury assets. During the period, the company expanded its board and advisory team, introduced new incentive arrangements and allocated capital to Bitcoin, tokenised gold and physical gold.
